name: Product and Service Risk
description: Inherent-risk factors relating to the products and services offered. Covers private banking, correspondent relationships, trade finance, prepaid instruments, virtual assets, safe deposit boxes and cash services.

sources.text: FATF, Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach (sector-specific guidance series, general principles)
FATF Recommendations, Recommendation 1 and Interpretive Note (assessing risks and applying a risk-based approach)
Wolfsberg Group, Guidance on a Risk Based Approach for Managing Money Laundering Risks (2006)

indicators.name: Private banking and wealth management
indicators.desc: High-net-worth relationships with bespoke structures, discretion expectations and large flows.
indicators.ctx: High-net-worth relationships with bespoke structures, discretion expectations and large flows.
indicators.fp: Most wealth clients are wholly legitimate.

indicators.name: Correspondent banking relationship
indicators.desc: Provision of accounts or payment services to other financial institutions that process on behalf of unknown customers.
indicators.ctx: Provision of accounts or payment services to other financial institutions that process on behalf of unknown customers.

indicators.name: Trade finance and documentary credits
indicators.desc: Products reliant on documentation that can be manipulated, with pricing and goods difficult to verify.
indicators.ctx: Products reliant on documentation that can be manipulated, with pricing and goods difficult to verify.

indicators.name: Prepaid and stored-value instruments
indicators.canon: Anonymous or lightly verified prepaid or stored-value instruments
indicators.desc: Prepaid cards or stored-value products without full ID, with high load limits, cross-border use or turnover inconsistent with design.
indicators.ctx: Anonymous or lightly verified instruments with high load limits or cross-border use.

indicators.name: Virtual asset services
indicators.desc: Provision of services enabling conversion, custody or transfer of virtual assets.
indicators.ctx: Provision of services enabling conversion, custody or transfer of virtual assets.
indicators.fp: Adoption of virtual assets for legitimate investment is widespread.

indicators.name: Safe deposit boxes
indicators.desc: Physical storage of unknown assets with limited visibility.
indicators.ctx: Physical storage of unknown assets with limited visibility.

indicators.name: Cash services and high-limit cash handling
indicators.canon: Cash services and high-limit cash handling
indicators.desc: Services involving large cash deposits, withdrawals, currency exchange or cash-in-transit.
indicators.ctx: Services involving large cash deposits, withdrawals, currency exchange or cash-in-transit.

indicators.name: Product enabling third-party payments
indicators.canon: Payable-through or pooled access enabling third-party payments
indicators.desc: Underlying customers of another party transact directly through payable-through, pooled or payment-agent facilities.
indicators.ctx: Services such as payable-through accounts, pooled accounts or payment agent facilities.
indicators.fp: Pooled accounts are standard for professionals.

indicators.name: New or innovative product without risk assessment
indicators.canon: New or innovative product without risk assessment
indicators.desc: Product launched without documented ML/TF risk assessment or controls.
indicators.ctx: Product launched without documented ML/TF risk assessment or controls.
indicators.fp: Minor variants may be assessed under existing products.

indicators.name: Cross-border payment and remittance services
indicators.desc: Services moving value across borders quickly through multiple intermediaries.
indicators.ctx: Services moving value across borders quickly through multiple intermediaries.

indicators.name: Anonymity-enhancing features
indicators.desc: Products permitting use without full identification, such as mixers, bearer-like instruments or unverified top-ups.
indicators.ctx: Products permitting use without full identification, such as mixers, bearer-like instruments or unverified top-ups.
indicators.fp: Privacy features can be sought for lawful reasons.
